verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Honeycomb accepts data in open formats: it ingests OpenTelemetry/OTLP, and an API manages datasets, queries and configuration. Nothing documents exporting all stored telemetry or account data in open formats for migration. Open-standard instrumentation lowers lock-in on the ingest side, but it is an adjacent capability, not data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
